name: ModelVariant816_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant816_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (while the ambient light dims, orbs, comets and spinners leave a model part and fly to jittered points on the opposing slot; each orb bursts into a fading glow, each comet into a glow and eight tumbling textured shards and each spinner into eight falling debris pieces, and once the last orb and comet have landed the light comes back); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request, seeds the orbs, comets and spinners and packs five texture images, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 0 before the start time, 4 once the first glow has opened, 1 once when the last orb and comet have landed after the emission end, 2 once the light has recovered and 0 otherwise; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-833 and 930 images build it from the same source with the US layout. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
